Sāyaṇa: agnir dvṛcena svātmanaḥ sarvātmakatvānubhavam āviṣkaroti, addressed to the Kuśikas; the world is twofold as bhoktṛ and bhogya; sākṣātkṛtaparatattvasvarūpo 'smi without śravaṇa and manana; bhoktṛrūpam ... bhogyarūpatām api anusaṃdhatte; closing tad anenāgneḥ sarvātmakatvapratipādanena parabrahmatvam uktaṃ bhavati. Every clause of the reading (seen the highest reality, self of all, eater and eaten, so the supreme Brahman) is in his words; Wilson note 2 concurs (enjoyer and enjoyed, food and feeder). He also offers a simpler yadvā reading, but omitting an alternative is not a false attribution, and the Brahman conclusion closes the whole comment. Plain sense matches day.js: Kusikas in 3.26.1 and 3.26.3, Agni Vaisvanara 3.26.1 to 3, storming Maruts 3.26.4 to 6, first person Agni in 3.26.7. verse.js ok at [259,7]; entry-check ok.
